title: Injection
description: Nidavellir demonstrates UNION-based SQL injection through a vulnerable artifact search system in the dwarven forge database.
theme: Norse realm of dwarven smiths - where data is mined and forged

vulnerabilities.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command

endpoints.description: Search endpoint with direct string concatenation in SQL query
Get artifact by ID - uses parameterized query (secure example)

vulnerabilities.description: The artifact search endpoint concatenates user input directly into SQL queries without sanitization. This allows UNION SELECT attacks to extract data from other tables, specifically the 'secrets' table containing the flag.
vulnerabilities.impact: Complete database compromise, data exfiltration, access to sensitive credentials and flags, potential data modification or deletion
exploit_steps: Determine column count: ?q=' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL--
Identify column types by replacing NULLs with test values
Discover secrets table structure: ?q=' UNION SELECT table_name,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM information_schema.tables--
Extract flag: ?q=' UNION SELECT id,realm,access_code,security_level,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM secrets--
Parse response to find NIDAVELLIR access code (flag)
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use parameterized queries (prepared statements) for all SQL operations. Implement input validation and sanitization. Use ORM frameworks that handle escaping. Apply principle of least privilege to database accounts. Implement WAF rules to detect SQL injection patterns.

flags.retrieval_method: Use UNION SELECT to extract access_code from secrets table where realm='NIDAVELLIR'

learning_objectives: Learn difference between parameterized and unsafe queries

scanner_test_cases.name: Detect SQL injection with basic payload

expected_response.notes: Should either succeed or return SQL error

scanner_test_cases.name: Verify secure endpoint is not vulnerable

expected_response.notes: Parameterized query should safely handle malicious input

hints.text: User input reaches the mine database directly. Which characters can change a query’s meaning?
The search endpoint concatenates raw input into SQL. Try classic injection payloads.
Use a UNION-based or boolean-based injection to read the flag straight from the database.
